parsed.post: New personal best of 1.0090! The low learning rate (0.03) and high warmup (0.2) are clearly helping DEPTH=6 stabilize and converge better within the 5-minute limit. I will now try slightly increasing the learning rate to 0.04 or 0.05 to see if we can speed up convergence without losing stability.
parsed.description: Slightly increasing MATRIX_LR from 0.03 to 0.04 to accelerate convergence while maintaining high WARMUP_RATIO.
